sentences.text: Part D covers sound and light signals.
Rule thirty-two defines a whistle as any device that can produce the prescribed blasts, a short blast as about one second, and a prolonged blast as four to six seconds.
Rule thirty-three sets the equipment by length.
A vessel twelve meters or more must carry a whistle.
A vessel twenty meters or more must carry a whistle and a bell.
A vessel one hundred meters or more must also carry a gong, whose tone can’t be confused with the bell.
A vessel under twelve meters isn’t required to carry these, but if she doesn’t, she must have some other means of making an efficient sound signal.
